messages:
Morgan: Hi — running into a subtle one in the sample app. When the access token expires mid-request, the SDK refresh+retry flow sometimes results in duplicate POSTs to our downstream write API. Repro steps below.

Morgan: Repro (quick): 1) set token lifetime very short 2) trigger concurrent requests 3) one request gets 401, triggers refresh, other continues and also retries -> two successful writes.

Morgan: Logs: 
```
[req A] POST /items  -> 401
[SDK] refresh token (async)
[req B] POST /items  -> 401
[SDK] refresh token resolves
[req A] retry POST /items -> 200
[req B] retry POST /items -> 200
```
No idempotency key used in sample app.

Alice: ouch. Is the SDK holding a refresh lock or letting both trigger refresh?

Morgan: Node SDK currently has no refresh lock, it races and both reissue original request after refresh. Go SDK had a lock but we discovered a linear-backoff bug there (backoff = base * attempts instead of exponential).

Samir: Two separate issues then: token-refresh coordination + backoff shape. Also need to differentiate safe replay for POSTs. For now server side idempotency is best, but SDK should help. :thumbsup:

Juan: Quick fixes I'd suggest: 1) refresh mutex so only one refresh inflight, others wait for refreshed token; 2) ensure retries add jitter and exponential backoff (base * 2^n +/- jitter); 3) sample app should send an Idempotency-Key header for non-idempotent endpoints.

Samir: Agreed. One more nuance — if you get 401 then refresh -> but downstream returns 429 while refresh in progress, naive retry loops can amplify the 429. We need to cap retries and use randomized jitter to avoid thundering herd.

Alice: For the Node SDK I can PR a small token lock wrapper. Pseudocode: 
```
if (isRefreshing) { await waitForRefresh(); } else { await acquireLock(); try { await refresh(); } finally { releaseLock(); notifyWaiters(); }}
```
That should stop double-refresh and reduce duplicate retries.

Morgan: Nice. For backoff: use algo we discussed in SDK patterns doc: 
```
delay = base * 2**attempt
jitter = random(-0.25, 0.25) * delay
sleep = clamp(delay + jitter, min, max)
```
And cap total retry time to ~10s for interactive flows.

Juan: Also add a small heuristic: if original request had a body and no Idempotency-Key, treat 5xx/429 as retryable but only once and only with idempotency fallback (i.e., warn). For 401 do refresh+single-retry under lock.

QA Runner: I'll add an e2e that spins up the sample app with token TTL=1s and concurrent POSTs to assert only one write is persisted. I'll also add scenario that injects 429 to verify jitter prevents spikes.

DevEx Bot: CI note — existing flaky test samples/post_retry_test failed 3/10 runs. Tagging @Alice @Samir for follow-up.

Morgan: Action items: Alice -> token-lock PR (Node) // Samir -> backoff+jit commit (shared lib) // Juan -> sample app idempotency header example // QA Runner -> e2e tests. I'll draft a short changelog blurb for SDK breaking behavior.

Alice: I'll open PR today, include changelog and a small migration note.

Samir: I'll land backoff changes behind feature flag so we can rollout.

Morgan: Thanks all. Quick check-in tomorrow after PRs. :coffee:
